mapper.update: UPDATE reservation_finances SET received_amount=#{amount}, payment_method=#{method}, received_at=#{receivedAt}, updated_at=now() WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reservationId, r.reservation_no AS reservationNo, r.guest_name AS guestName, r.guest_phone AS guestPhone, rooms.room_number AS roomNumber, r.check_in_date AS checkInDate, r.check_out_date AS checkOutDate, r.checked_in_at AS checkedInAt, r.checked_out_at AS checkedOutAt, r.guest_count AS guestCount, r.total_amount AS totalAmount, COALESCE(f.received_amount, 0) AS receivedAmount, COALESCE(f.refund_amount, 0) AS refundAmount, f.payment_method AS paymentMethod, f.received_at AS receivedAt, f.refunded_at AS refundedAt, r.reservation_status AS reservationStatus, r.payment_status AS paymentStatus FROM reservations r JOIN rooms ON rooms.id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN reservation_finances f ON f.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.check_in_date >= #{startDate} AND r.check_in_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY r.check_in_date, r.id
